column1: # Every claim this project makes that something can check, and the check.
# ONE ROW PER CLAIM. Tab-separated: id, tags, speed, claim, command.
# speed is fast or slow; slow rows run only under FULL=1.
# A task that proves something adds a row here, and it is checked from then on.

column5: for f in Casks/*.rb; do ruby -c "$f" >/dev/null || exit 1; done
